title: Processed eddy covariance carbon flux data and analysis scripts for Michigan apple orchards (2023–2025)
description: This repository contains processed eddy covariance carbon flux data, quality-control and manual-review records, analysis scripts, figures, and manuscript-supporting tables for a study of Michigan apple orchards from 2023 through 2025. Funding was provided by Nestlé-Gerber, the Michigan Tree Fruit Commission, and Michigan State University AgBioResearch.
